instrument_type_details.notes: UAL 2012 hedge portfolio: heating oil collars 11% ($3.13 max, $2.52 min/gal), heating oil calls 7% ($3.22/gal), Brent crude collars 6% ($2.74 max, $1.91 min/gal), diesel collars 4% ($3.12 max, $2.35 min/gal), aircraft fuel swaps 1% ($2.90/gal), WTI crude calls 1% ($2.37/gal), WTI crude swaps 1% ($2.25/gal). Total 31% max price protection, 23% min price protection. ~47% of Q1 2012 hedged with decreasing coverage. UAL includes United ($44M FV) + Continental ($29M FV) subsidiaries.

warnings: Fuel cost 37% of total operating expenses in 2011 (up from 31% in 2010)
A 10% decrease in forward fuel prices would reduce UAL hedge fair value by $155M (sensitivity disclosure)
$1/bbl price increase impacts UAL annual fuel expense by $95M (2012 projection)
